readme_facts: Archive contains a WinZip compressed file of 66 raw Kongsberg-Simrad EM12 files and ship navigation from CD169.
Some raw EM12 files were corrupt and could not be processed and are omitted, causing an incomplete numbering sequence.

processed_companion.readme_fact: This companion disc contains processed ASCII EM12 bathymetry, not raw EM12 pings.

important_correction: Earlier inference that the accessible BODC archive lacked raw shipborne EM12 was false when based only on sd11281. Full archive search found the separate sd11280 raw EM12 package.
